name: Oakland
local_rules: City of Oakland Parking Services handles parking citation appeals; online portal and mail options available. Appealed citations go through the City of Oakland Administrative Hearings process.

appeal_mail_address.department: Oakland Department of Transportation (Oakland Parking Enforcement)

verification_metadata.notes: URL confirmed on official .gov domain. Path explicitly references appeals-and-hearings, indicating dispute functionality rather than payment-only. No mail address conflict identified in this verification step — locked address from prior step remains primary.

special_requirements.notes: Appeals submitted via online portal or by mail to the Administrative Hearings office

confirmation_note: Oakland gives you 21 days from the notice to contest. After that, the city may add late fees or automatically enter a default judgment. Oakland offers an online dispute portal. You can check the official city site for the most up-to-date contest instructions before mailing.
